deadline.value: January 15 standard deadline for fall admission

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Environmental Science/Sustainability subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Each faculty member in the Golisano Institute for Sustainability sponsors a select number of students for specific research projects; admission is tied to sponsored project acceptance.
supervisor.quote: Each faculty member in the Golisano Institute for Sustainability sponsors a select number of students for specific research projects, with the scope varying from fundamental science to applied engineering to corporate sustainability applications. On acceptance into a sponsored research project, you will receive a fully-funded education, a stipend to help with living expenses

funding.value: Fully-funded education with living stipend upon acceptance into sponsored research project.
funding.quote: On acceptance into a sponsored research project, you will receive a fully-funded education, a stipend to help with living expenses, your own office space

entry_route.value: Direct admission from baccalaureate degree is accepted.
entry_route.quote: Hold a baccalaureate degree (or US equivalent) from an accredited university or college.
